scope: One existing managed Spanner GoogleSQL database in a regional Enterprise trial in asia-northeast1. Single-use read-only queries in NORMAL mode.
replay: Extract the input objects in order with jq ' [.cases[].input] ' and pass the array to the linked managed producer. JSON numeric parameters decode as FLOAT64 in this producer.
result_format: Successful rows use the Spanner protobuf JSON wire representation. The fields retain the SQL result types. Error diagnostics retain their first line with source positions removed.
